data.audience_summary: The Oatly audience in London skews slightly female and indexes strongly towards wellness-conscious, mindful consumers in their mid-to-late twenties and forties who value sustainability and ethical living. They deeply connect with lifestyle content around mindful eating, travel, and personal growth.
watch_outs: Avoid overly clinical wellness tropes; keep the tone playful, grounded, and community-focused.
data.headline: Conscious, creative, and community-driven: engaging London's mindful wellness seekers through sustainable lifestyle partnerships.
